name: Hello World!
source:
The town is still, but Rin is there, watching, guiding, asking questions. What seems like a gentle afternoon slowly twists into something fragile and uncanny, a day where every choice leaves a mark – and some marks aren’t easily forgotten.

[From [url=https://hollowfable.itch.io/hello-world]Itch.io[/url]]
